MENU_QUICK_DESC: Amawanga abiri gonna, ekisaawe kyonna. Pasi ya wakati ya ggwe.
MENU_CUP_DESC: Amawanga munaana, ebibinja bibiri, semi-fayinolo ne fayinolo.
MENU_CUP_CONTINUE: Ekikopo kyo kigenda mu maaso. Weeyongereyo.
MENU_HOWTO_DESC: Ekisaawe, ebifo omusanvu n'amateeka gonna abalamuzi ge bakozesa.
QUARTERS_NOTE: Omupiira omutuufu gulina ebitundu bina, buli kimu ddakiika 15. Essaawa teyimirira ku ggoolo; eyimirira lwa kulumizibwa kwokka.
DOUBLE_ZONE_NOTE: Etteeka lya liigi: mu ddakiika etaano ezisembayo eza buli kitundu, ggoolo okuva ku mita 3 oba okusingawo ebalibwa bbiri.
DIFF_EASY_DESC: Abazibizi baabwe balwawo okutegeera pasi zo, era tebatera kuzikwata.
DIFF_NORMAL_DESC: Ttiimu ya kiraabu ennungi: pasi enafu bajja kugikwata.
DIFF_PRO_DESC: Ttiimu y'eggwanga: bategeera amangu omuzannyo, kizibu okubayitamu.
DIFF_LEGEND_DESC: Abasinga mu nsi yonna. Buli pasi enafu bagikwata.
BIB_TEAM_NOTE: Ozannya oyo alina omupiira, n'omuzibizi asinga okuba okumpi nagwo.
PLAY_AS_NOTE: Ttiimu: ofuga oyo alina omupiira. Ekifo kimu: londa bib ku ssirini enkulu omuzannye omupiira gwonna, nga omuzannyi bw'akola.
KEEP_ONSIDE_NOTE: Kiriko: omuzannyi wo ayimirira ku nsalo y'ebifo ekifo kye bye kikkirizibwa. Kiggyeko: weesala layini, omulamuzi alangirira ofusaayidi.
POS_ROLE_GA: Ateeba, aliisa omuteebi era ayita mu kitundu ekya wakati.
POS_ROLE_WA: Aliisa enkulungo ng'ali ku mabbali gaayo; y'asooka okulowoozebwako ku pasi ya wakati.
POS_ROLE_C: Akwata pasi ya wakati era ayunga abazibizi n'abalumbi mu kisaawe kyonna.
POS_ROLE_WD: Akuuma Wing Attack era aziyiza pasi ezigenda mu nkulungo.
POS_ROLE_GD: Akuuma Goal Attack, mu nkulungo ne wabweru waayo.
POS_ROLE_GK: Akuuma Goal Shooter, aziyiza okuteeba era akwata omupiira ogudda.
POS_AREAS_GS: Ebifo: ekitundu eky'okulumba n'enkulungo ya ggoolo.
POS_AREAS_GA: Ebifo: ekitundu ekya wakati, eky'okulumba n'enkulungo ya ggoolo.
POS_AREAS_WA: Ebifo: ekitundu ekya wakati n'eky'okulumba, si nkulungo.
POS_AREAS_C: Ebifo: ebitundu byonna ebisatu, si nkulungo yonna.
POS_AREAS_WD: Ebifo: ekitundu ekya wakati n'eky'okwekuuma, si nkulungo.
POS_AREAS_GD: Ebifo: ekitundu ekya wakati, eky'okwekuuma n'enkulungo ya ggoolo.
POS_AREAS_GK: Ebifo: ekitundu eky'okwekuuma n'enkulungo ya ggoolo.
GFX_NOTE: Wansi kirungi ku ssimu ez'ebbeeyi entono: tewali nsalo, abalabi batono. Otomatiki bw'eba eriko, omupiira ogutambula mpola mu sikonda ezisooka gukka omutendera gumu gwokka.
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: Ebifaananyi nga {n} buli sikonda, ebitonoko: essimu tebuguma era bbatire ewangaala.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: Ebifaananyi {n} buli sikonda ku ssirini yo eya {hz} Hz: biseeyeeya bulungi, era tibimalawo bbatire nga ekisinga.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: Ebifaananyi byonna ssirini yo eya {hz} Hz by'esobola.
MOVE_BUTTONS_NOTE: Sika buli ppeesa olitwale engalo yo w'erisanga. Lisigala awo.
ABOUT_DISCLAIMER: Omuzannyo ogwetongodde. Ttiimu ze nsi ezikozesa amannya gazo agamanyiddwa; buli linnya ly'omuzannyi lyagunjibwa. Tegukwatagana na kitongole kyonna ekifuga, liigi oba empaka.
LICENCES_INTRO: Omuzannyo guzimbiddwa ne pulogulamu ez'obwereere era eziggule. Layisinsi zaazo zisaba obubaka buno bulagibwe; buli mu Lungereza, nga bwe bwawandiikibwa.
RULES_COURT_TEXT: Mita 30.5 obuwanvu ne 15.25 obugazi, mu bitundu bisatu. Wakati enkulungo ya wakati egazi mita 0.9; ku buli ludda enkulungo ya ggoolo: ekitundu ky'enkulungo kya mita 4.9 okuva ku kikondo. Empeta eri mita 3.05 waggulu, nga tewali kipande mabega.
RULES_TEAMS_TEXT: Buli muzannyi ayambala bib eriko ekifo kye, era ayingira mu bifo by'ekifo kye byokka. Ttiimu ewandiisa abazannyi okutuuka ku 12; enkyukakyuka zikolebwa mu biwummulo, oluvannyuma lwa ggoolo bwe zisabibwa, ne ku kulumizibwa.
RULES_GOAL_TEXT: Goal Shooter ne Goal Attack bokka be bayinza okuteeba, era nga bali mu nkulungo ya ggoolo. Omupiira gulina okuyita mu mpeta yonna. Omupiira oguva mu ngalo ze nga efirimbi tennafuuyibwa gubalibwa.
RULES_CENTRE_TEXT: Buli kitundu kitandika na pasi ya wakati, n'omuzannyo oluvannyuma lwa buli ggoolo. Ttiimu zikyusakyusa, k'abe ani ateebye. Centre ayimirira mu nkulungo ya wakati; abalala balindira mu bitundu byabwe ebya ggoolo okutuusa efirimbi, era pasi erina okukwatibwa mu kitundu ekya wakati.
RULES_TIME_TEXT: Ebitundu bina, buli kimu ddakiika 15, nga waliwo ddakiika nnya wakati w'ekisooka n'eky'okubiri, n'eky'okusatu n'eky'okuna, ate 12 ku kiwummulo kya wakati. Ttiimu zikyusa enjuyi buli kitundu.
RULES_EXTRA_TEXT: Omupiira bwe gulina okuvaamu omuwanguzi nga benkanya: ebitundu bibiri ebya ddakiika okutuuka ku musanvu, ddakiika emu wakati, olwo ne bazannya okutuusa ttiimu emu lw'ekulembera ne ggoolo bbiri.
RULES_FOOTWORK_TEXT: Ng'alina omupiira tadduka. Ekigere ky'asooka okutuulako kye kigere ekikulu: ayinza okulinnya n'ekirala ne yeekyusa ng'ali ku kikulu, naye bw'akisitula alina okugaba oba okuteeba nga tekinnaddamu kukwata wansi. Pasi ya bwereere eri ttiimu endala.
RULES_THREE_TEXT: Alina okugaba oba okuteeba mu sikonda ssatu ng'amaze okukwata omupiira. Okulwisa omupiira: pasi ya bwereere.
RULES_OBSTRUCTION_TEXT: Omuzibizi agezaako okuziyiza oba okuggyako omupiira alina okuyimirira waakiri mita 0.9 okuva ku kigere ekikulu eky'omuzannyi agulina. Bw'asembera okusingawo, kuba kuziyiza: pasi ya peneti.
RULES_CONTACT_TEXT: Tewali kukwatako okutaataaganya omuzannyo gw'omuvuganya: okusindika, okukwata, okukuba omupiira mu ngalo ze, oba obutaleka muzannyi akutte omupiira bbanga kugwa. Pasi ya peneti.
RULES_OFFSIDE_TEXT: Omuzannyi ayingira ekifo ekifo kye kye kitakkirizibwamu, ng'alina omupiira oba nga talina, aba ofusaayidi. Layini zibalibwa mu bifo bye zeetooloola. Pasi ya bwereere.
RULES_THIRD_TEXT: Omupiira tegusuulibwa kusukka kitundu kyonna nga tewali muzannyi mu kitundu ekyo agukwata oba agukoonako. Pasi ya bwereere.
RULES_SHORT_TEXT: Wakati w'agaba n'akwata walina okubaawo ebbanga omuvuganya mw'ayinza okugukwatira. Pasi ya bwereere.
RULES_OUT_TEXT: Omupiira ogugwa ebweru w'ekisaawe guweebwa ttiimu etaasembyeyo kugukwatako: gusuulibwa munda okuva we gwasalidde layini, mu sikonda ssatu.
RULES_PENALTIES: Pasi za bwereere ne za peneti
RULES_PENALTIES_TEXT: Pasi ya bwereere egabibwa awakoleddwa ensobi, omuzannyi yenna akkirizibwa awo. Ku pasi ya peneti, omuzannyi abonerezeddwa ayimirira ku mabbali g'agaba, nga takola kantu, okutuusa omupiira lwe guvudde mu ngalo. Mu nkulungo ya ggoolo, peneti eyinza okuba pasi oba okuteeba.
RULES_ADVANTAGE_TEXT: Omulamuzi aleka omuzannyo ne gugenda mu maaso singa okugusiba kwandifiiriza ttiimu ekoleddwako ensobi: ng'omuteebi agenda okuteeba. Alangirira enkizo n'ensobi.
RULES_SANCTIONS_TEXT: Ku muzannyo ogw'obulabe oba ensobi eziddiŋŋana, omulamuzi ayinza okulabula omuzannyi, okumuyimiriza ddakiika bbiri ez'omuzannyo, oba okumugoba. Okuva mu 2024 tewakyali toss-up: abazannyi babiri bwe basobya omulundi gumu, ttiimu eyasembyeyo okuba n'omupiira egusigaza.
RULES_DZ_TEXT: Liigi ezimu zizannya n'enjawulo. Omuzannyo guno guwa Double Zone: mu ddakiika etaano ezisembayo eza buli kitundu, ggoolo okuva ku mita 3 oba okusingawo okuva ku kikondo ebalibwa bbiri.
CTRL_MOVE_TEXT: Ekinkumu kya kkono wonna ku ludda lwa kkono olwa ssirini ye joystick: kidduusa omuzannyi wo (empeta ya kiragala ekyaka). Dduka mu bbanga eryereere ofune pasi.
CTRL_PASS_TEXT: Ng'alina omupiira tasobola kudduka. Sindika joystick eri munno gw'oyagala (empeta eraga ani), olwo PASI ku pasi ey'ekifuba oba ey'ekibegabega, oba WAGGULU okuyisa waggulu w'omuzibizi. Empeta waggulu w'omupiira ze sikonda zo essatu.
CTRL_SHOOT_TEXT: TEEBA erabika Goal Shooter oba Goal Attack wo bw'aba n'omupiira mu nkulungo. Okusemberera kwongera obukakafu; omukono gw'omuzibizi waggulu w'omupiira gukizibuwaza.
CTRL_DEFEND_TEXT: KUUMA eyimusa emikono gyo waggulu w'omupiira. Tunuulira empeta okwetooloola ekigere kye ekikulu: kiragala kikkirizibwa, emmyufu kitegeeza oli kumpi okusinga mita 0.9 era omulamuzi ajja kulangirira okuziyiza.
CTRL_INTERCEPT_TEXT: NYAKULA ebuuka okukwata pasi eri mu bbanga bw'oba osobola okugituukako mu budde. Bw'obuukira omuzannyi akutte omupiira, kuba kukwatako.
CTRL_PLAY_AS_TEXT: Bw'ozannya nga ttiimu, ofuga oyo alina omupiira, era KYUSA ekutwala ku muzibizi asinga okuba okumpi n'omupiira. Londa bib ku ssirini enkulu ozannye ekifo kimu omupiira gwonna.
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD oba obusaale okutambula, Space ku ppeesa erisooka, J ne K ku malala, Esc okuyimiriza.
INTERVAL_NOTE: Ekiwummulo kya ddakiika {min}; Weeyongereyo etandika {next} kati.
TEAM_CHANGES_NOTE: Nyiga ekifo oyingize omuzannyi addako ku katebe azannya ekifo ekyo.
CUP_ABOUT: Amawanga munaana agali okumpi n'eryo ku lukalala lw'ensi yonna, mu bibinja bibiri ebya ttiimu nnya. Ebibiri ebisooka mu buli kibinja biyitawo ku semi-fayinolo; oluvannyuma fayinolo n'omupiira gw'ekikomo. Obubonero bubiri ku buwanguzi, kamu ku maliri; abenkanya baawulwa ku bitundu ku kikumi bya ggoolo.
CUP_OUT: Ovuddemu. Ekikopo kigenda mu maaso awatali ggwe.
RECORDS_EMPTY: Zannya omupiira, ebyafaayo byo bitandikire wano.
TIMEOUTS_NOTE: Etteeka lya liigi: buli ludda lusaba okuwummulako kwa sikonda 90 emirundi ebiri buli kitundu ekinene, oluvannyuma lwa ggoolo. Kiri mu kuyimiriza.
ROLLING_NOTE: Etteeka lya liigi: kola enkyukakyuka mu ttiimu essaawa yonna okuva mu menyu y'okuyimiriza, so si mu biwummulo byokka.
TIME_OUT_NOTE: Sikonda 90, essaawa eyimiriziddwa. Kola enkyukakyuka mu ttiimu kati; Weeyongereyo bw'oba weetegese.
INJURY_NOTE: Omuzannyi wa {team} alumiziddwa. Ttiimu erina sikonda 30 okumuyamba okuva mu kisaawe; ttiimu zombi ziyinza okukyusa abazannyi. Weeyongereyo bw'oba weetegese.
UMP_FEWER_NOTE: Abazannyi abalala bawa kitundu kya peneti eza bulijjo.
UMP_STANDARD_NOTE: Nga kimu kya kusatu ku peneti z'omupiira gw'abakugu, omuzannyo gutambule.
UMP_REAL_NOTE: Peneti nnyingi ng'omupiira gw'abakugu: nga 50 buli ttiimu mu ddakiika 60.
COACH_TIPS_NOTE: Amagezi amampi mu mupiira, buli limu omulundi ogusooka lw'oliteetaaga. Gaggwaako ng'omaze omupiira gwo ogusooka gwonna.
COACH_MOVE: Tambula ne joystick ku kkono. Ozannya oyo alina empeta ya kiragala ekyaka; ennukuta ku bib ye ziraga w'ayinza okugenda.
COACH_PASS: Olina omupiira: tosobola kudduka nagwo, era olina okugaba mu sikonda ssatu. Nyiga {pass} okugusuula ku mpeta ey'obutonnyeze, oba sooka olage omuntu ne joystick.
COACH_SHOOT: Oli mu nkulungo ya ggoolo: nyiga {shoot}. Gy'okoma okusemberera ekikondo, gy'okoma okuteeba obulungi.
COACH_FOOTWORK: Ng'okutte omupiira oyimirira butereevu: joystick ekukyusa kyusa. {lob} eyisa omupiira waggulu w'omuzibizi omuwanvu.
COACH_DEFEND: Bo be balina omupiira. Ddukira omuzannyi omukuume. {defend} eyimusa emikono gyo, naye beera mita 0.9 emabega: empeta efuuka emmyufu bw'osemberera ennyo.
COACH_INTERCEPT: Pasi eri mu bbanga: nyiga {intercept} ogibuukire. {switch} ekutwala ku munno asinga okuba okumpi n'omupiira.
COACH_WHISTLE: Efirimbi: obubaka waggulu bulaga ensobi ki, ne ttiimu erina omupiira kati.
COACH_AREAS: Buli kifo kirina ebitundu byakyo eby'ekisaawe: bw'obivaamu kuba ofusaayidi. Maapu ziri mu Engeri y'okuzannya.
MENU_LEAGUE_DESC: Kiraabu munaana, emitendera musanvu, oluvannyuma fayinolo.
MENU_LEAGUE_CONTINUE: Sizoni yo egenda mu maaso. Weeyongereyo.
LEAGUE_ABOUT: Kiraabu munaana okuva Awusitureeliya, New Zealand, Bungereza ne South Afrika zizannyagana omulundi gumu. Ennya ezisooka ziyitawo ku fayinolo: eyokusooka ezannya eyokuna, eyokubiri ezannya eyokusatu, abawanguzi ne basisinkana mu fayinolo ennene. Obubonero bubiri ku buwanguzi, kamu ku maliri; abenkanya baawulwa ku bitundu ku kikumi bya ggoolo.
LEAGUE_OUT: Kiraabu yo tetuuse ku fayinolo. Fayinolo zigenda mu maaso awatali ggwe.
